note: Minimum BM25 metrics on the PersianQA test split. Each value is the committed baseline (results/bm25_test_k1-1.2_b-0.75.json: recall@1 0.9094, recall@10 0.9816, mrr@10 0.9372) minus 0.01, rounded down to a multiple of 0.005. BM25 is deterministic, so any drop is a real change of the tokenizer, normalizer or index, not noise. Dense retrieval and reranking are not gated: they need a model download that CI does not do.
